scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agromilk/shared build && pnpm --filter @agromilk/web build && pnpm --filter @agromilk/api build
scripts.build:netlify: pnpm --dir packages/shared build && pnpm --dir apps/web build && node scripts/prepare-netlify.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @agromilk/shared build && pnpm --filter @agromilk/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @agromilk/api typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @agromilk/shared build && pnpm --filter @agromilk/web test && pnpm --filter @agromilk/api test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @agromilk/shared build && pnpm --filter @agromilk/web test:coverage && pnpm --filter @agromilk/api test:coverage
